CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[GetAssetTypeAncestry] ( @id int ) RETURNS @tbl TABLE ( ID int, [Level] int ) AS BEGIN declare @max int; declare @t table (SubjectAssetTypeID int, ObjectAssetTypeID int, [Level] int); with T as ( select IT.SubjectAssetTypeID, IT.ObjectAssetTypeID, 0 as [Level] from AssetType A inner join IntersectTypeDetail IT on IT.ObjectAssetTypeID = A.ID and IT.PredicateType in (3,4) where A.ID = @id
union all
select IT.SubjectAssetTypeID, A.ID as ObjectAssetTypeID, T.[Level]-1 as [Level] from AssetType A inner join T on T.SubjectAssetTypeID = A.ID outer apply ( select * from IntersectTypeDetail where ObjectAssetTypeID = A.ID and PredicateType in (3,4) ) IT ) insert into @t select * from T
select @max = abs(min([Level])) from @t
update @t set [Level] = [Level] + @max+1
if not exists (select 1 from @t) begin insert into @t values (null, @id, 1) end
insert into @tbl select ObjectAssetTypeID as ID, [Level] from @t order by [Level]
RETURN END
